summary: Iter40 eSign verification: all 4 issues PASS. Backend tests for Issue C+D (witness/next-signer preview of other signers' signed fields) all pass (3/3 new + 22/22 regression). Frontend code-level + live verification confirms Issue A (Void icon-only XCircle, no text) and Issue B (sticky aside with both Active-field card and Finish-signing card staying visible on scroll).
infrastructure_setup: PostgreSQL 15 was NOT installed in this preview env at the time of testing despite Phase 38 note. Installed via 'apt-get install postgresql postgresql-contrib', started pg_ctlcluster, created realprofits user/db, restarted backend (auto-created tables via SQLAlchemy on startup). All backend services healthy after fix.

verifications.issue_a_void_icon_only: PASS — EsignDashboard.tsx:240-249 confirms button renders only <XCircle className='w-4 h-4'/> with data-testid=void-{id}, title='Void document', aria-label='Void document'. NO 'Void' text in the row.
verifications.issue_b_sticky_aside: PASS — SigningPage.tsx:299 aside has classes 'lg:sticky lg:top-24 lg:self-start lg:max-h-[calc(100vh-7rem)] lg:overflow-y-auto'. Live test (1920x1080, scrolled 800px) confirmed BOTH 'Create your signature' card and 'Finish signing' card remain visible. main uses items-start so sticky child works.
verifications.issue_c_d_witness_preview_backend: PASS — GET /api/esign/sign/{token} returns {other_filled_fields:[], signers:[{id,name,role,order_index,color,status,signed_at}]}. After signer1 submits a data:image/png signature, both signer2 and witness GET responses include other_filled_fields[0] with value starting 'data:image' and signer1's field bbox + signer_id. Tested via test_esign_iter40.py — 3/3 passing.
verifications.issue_c_d_witness_preview_frontend: PASS — SigningPage.tsx:217-251 renders data-testid='other-signed-field-{fieldId}' overlays with pointer-events-none, owner color from signers summary, for data:image values or text span otherwise.

regression_iter39: PASS — test_esign_invoice_iter39.py + test_esign_api.py: 22 tests passing (auth redirect, draft open, In Progress tab, drag-drop signers, sticky FieldPlacer sidebar, invoice qty/description format, eSign Home link, no usage progress bar).
action_items: OPS: PostgreSQL 15 was missing from this preview pod. Installed manually and started — confirm container image / Phase 38 bootstrap script actually provisions it on fresh containers, otherwise backend will 500 on every eSign API call after a pod restart.
critical_code_review_comments: EsignDashboard.tsx is now ~270 lines — healthy. SigningPage.tsx is 474 lines — consider splitting overlay rendering and side-panel into sub-components if it grows further (>700 line guideline).
schemas.py is large (~650 lines) — split into resource-specific files (signer.py, field.py, document.py) for maintainability.
Frontend live test confirmed both sticky cards visible after 800px scroll — UX intent satisfied.
seed_data_creation: TEST_iter40_* documents created during pytest fixtures and live UI test were cleaned up post-test via DELETE FROM documents WHERE title LIKE 'TEST_%'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PostgreSQL is now running (pg_ctlcluster 15 main start). If you re-spin the pod and eSign endpoints 500 with 'Cannot assign requested address', re-run: apt-get install -y postgresql postgresql-contrib && pg_ctlcluster 15 main start && create user/db (realprofits/realprofits_dev, db realprofits_esign). Test pattern for minting JWT signing tokens in tests: import esign.tokens, call create_signing_token(sid,did,email), hash via hash_token, UPDATE signers SET token_hash=... via psql. See test_esign_iter40.py for the full pattern.
